install: Copy .xaml files to %APPDATA%\FlowLauncher\Themes\ and choose in Settings -> Appearance
installSteps: Copy `Cyclorama Dawn.xaml`, `Cyclorama Steel.xaml`, and `Cyclorama Day.xaml` into `%APPDATA%\FlowLauncher\Themes\`.
Restart Flow Launcher and open **Settings -> Appearance -> Theme**.
author: Real-Fruit-Snacks

themes.name: Cyclorama Dawn
themes.tagline: Matte #050507 spotlight dialog with crisp #62646D frame, Beacon Orange caret/matches, and Steel Blue clock readout.
themes.copySnippet:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
                    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
    <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
        <ResourceDictionary Source="pack://application:,,,/Themes/Base.xaml" />
    </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="ItemSelectedBackgroundColor" Color="#FF38241C" />
    <Style x:Key="WindowBorderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Border}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F5050507" />
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#FF62646D" />
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1" />
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="WindowStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Window}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F5050507" />
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF4F5F8" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="QueryBoxStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseQueryTextBoxStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBox}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF4F5F8" />
        <Setter Property="CaretBrush" Value="#FFF06E2B" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="ItemTitleStyle" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFD6D8E0" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="ItemTitleSelectedStyle" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF4F5F8" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="ItemSubTitleSelectedStyle" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFFF9254" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="HighlightStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Run}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFFF9254" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="SeparatorStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
        <Setter Property="Fill" Value="#FF2A2C35" />
    </Style>
</ResourceDictionary>
